title: Demo plan
description: The one document a human approves before a demo is produced: the storyboard (scenes, narration), how to run the app (runtime: an authorization without its schema and storyboard hash, including any run-local interaction helpers), which user-visible features are shown or omitted and why, the narrator label, approved helper files, outside destinations the app may reach, and a cost estimate. Approval is the human passing its sha256 to `sdp demo --confirm-plan-sha256`; nothing inside the file grants approval.

voices.description: On-screen and caption label of the narrator, the generated voice that explains what is on screen in every demo. Media from run-local helpers are labelled by their authorization media entries, not here.

features.description: One entry per user-visible catalog capability: the scenes that show it, or why it is left out.

helpers.description: Small approved files (for example a static file server for a page with no server of its own) copied into the run workspace as helpers/<file> after their sha256 is checked. Commands refer to them as {workspace}/helpers/<file>. They run with the same limits as the app.

source.description: skill: a file bundled in this skill's scripts/helpers; plan-dir: a file in a helpers folder next to the plan file.

externalDestinations.description: Hosts outside this machine that the app's own processes are expected to reach (for example a cloud AI endpoint). Declared so the human sees them; the browser is still limited to the app's loopback origin, but app processes are not network-sandboxed in the default path.

cloud.description: Whether the run uses paid services.

amountUsd.description: Estimated worst-case spend for one demo run; null when cloud is false.

maxRunSeconds.description: Whole-run time limit; the run is cancelled and cleaned up when it is reached.

allowArchitectureCards.description: A product demo shows the running app, not slides. Only when true may scenes carry an architecture diagram card.

storyboard.description: A complete storyboard.v1, checked with that contract.

runtime.description: A run-authorization.v1 without schema, storyboardSha256 and approvalRecord, checked with that contract after the storyboard hash is added.
